svg.text: Figure 4.1. The router of tile 0: the router of tiles 1–63 plus a fifth port for C&C
v1.0 (spec/machine-spec.md §4.6, §4.7, §4.16) — tiles 1–63 plus the fifth port; 102-bit packets

g.text: each grey bar is one FIFO, 16 entries × 102 bits (queue_depth);
one FIFO per feeder, a round-robin selector per output
routes each packet by its mode
read returns first, then the send port
(the router adds src: 102 bits on the link)
C&C's route block routes as an injection at tile 0:
it never waits behind tile 0's injection point

svg.text: Tile 0's router is the router of tiles 1–63 (figure 4.2) plus a sixth route block for packets from C&C, a from-C&C FIFO (orange) on each of the
five outputs, so C&C gets a fair round-robin share of each, and a sixth output, to C&C, with five FIFOs of its own: ten extra FIFOs in all.
